微短剧：褪去“虚火”方能健康前行（艺文观察）: Short-form Series: Shedding "Speculative Fever" for Healthy Development (Arts and Culture Observation)
AIGC（人工智能生成内容）技术正以前所未有的速度重塑视听内容生产方式，大幅降低: AIGC (artificial intelligence-generated content) technology is reshaping audiovisual content production methods at an unprecedented pace, significantly lowering the creation threshold and allowing the creativity of hundreds of millions of people to be fully unleashed.
AI（人工智能）赋能贯穿创作全流程，极大提升了生产效率，拓展了内容生态的广度与深: AI (artificial intelligence) empowerment permeates the entire creative workflow, vastly improving production efficiency and expanding the breadth and depth of content ecology.
这是我国首部微短剧领域专项部门规章，恰逢其时地为AIGC创作带来方向性指引和规范: This is China's first departmental regulation specialized in the short-form series field, timely providing directional guidance and standardized management for AIGC creation.
新规专门针对AI生成微短剧增设约束条款：要求制作和播出机构在每集明显位置添加AI: The new regulation specifically adds restrictive clauses for AI-generated short-form series: requiring production and broadcast institutions to add AI indication labels in prominent positions in each episode, requiring platforms not to use recommendation mechanisms that induce user addiction, and clarifying content review and value orientation standards.
一些低质内容会被用于AI训练，形成“泔水投喂泔水”的恶性循环: Some low-quality content will be used for AI training, forming a vicious cycle of "feeding swill with swill."
算力之上有心力，算法之下有理法: Above computing power lies human spirit; beneath algorithms lies the rule of law.
现在很多AI剧创作机构或OPC（一人公司）很着急，紧盯市场行情变化，一个类型火了: Many AI drama creation institutions or OPCs (one-person companies) are now anxious, closely watching market trends, and as soon as one genre becomes hot, hundreds of similar stories swarm in overnight, causing homogenization and mediocrity.
《办法》提出“把社会效益放在首位”“鼓励、支持优秀微短剧创作播出”“优先推荐优质: The "Measures" propose to "place social benefits first," "encourage and support excellent short-form series creation and broadcast," and "prioritize recommendations of quality short-form series," drawing lines and indicating directions for AI drama, with creation entities needing to align efforts particularly in these areas.
AI可以生成海量内容，但缺乏对真实人情的洞察: AI can generate vast amounts of content, but it lacks insight into genuine human relationships.
但创新不等于降格，当AI把门槛降到最低，审美就是区分平庸与精品的分水岭: But innovation is not the same as lowering standards; when AI lowers the threshold to the minimum, aesthetics becomes the dividing line between mediocrity and excellence.
AI时代创作者最需要学习的不是工具操作，而是影视语言语法: What creators most need to learn in the AI era is not tool operation, but the grammar of audiovisual language.
未来AI导演比拼的不是技术，而是审美: In the future, competition among AI directors will not be about technology, but about aesthetics.
AIGC降低创作门槛，大量新人涌入，这是繁荣的大好机会: AIGC lowers the creation threshold, attracting large numbers of newcomers, which is a great opportunity for prosperity.
但AI的低成本不等于没成本——千百万人的海量创作，正在争夺宝贵的算力资源: But AI's low cost does not mean zero cost—the massive output from hundreds of millions of people is competing for precious computing power resources.
AIGC技术发展正快马加鞭，抢占潮头: AIGC technology development is galloping ahead, seizing the tide of the times.
AI剧创作却不宜急躁，不能放下对品质的坚守、对规律的尊重、对人民精神文化需求的责: AI drama creation should not be hasty, and must not abandon commitment to quality, respect for artistic principles, and responsibility for meeting the people's spiritual and cultural needs.
面对蓬勃发展的人工智能，今天的舞蹈教育正沿着两条主线稳步推进：一条是全民美育浸润: Facing the vigorous development of artificial intelligence, today's dance education is steadily advancing along two main lines: one is the humanistic main line of all-people aesthetic education, and the other is the innovation main line of deep artificial intelligence empowerment.
尤其要看到的是，人工智能是高效的育人赋能工具，但无法替代舞蹈教育中真实的人际互动: In particular, it should be recognized that artificial intelligence is an efficient humanistic empowerment tool, but it cannot replace the real human interaction and artistic transmission in dance education.
